scientific_limitations_and_integrity: A full all-size proof and integer-only checks for small cycles are supplied. The earlier 2009 paper was accessible only in abstract and citation form; undiscovered rank-enumeration coverage remains a disclosed originality risk. No historical priority or independent validation is certified.
title: Exact image-rank profile and mean of endomorphism monoids of finite cycles
